## Postlet v1.0.0

Contact- and conversation-first desktop mail client built with **Tauri 2**.

### Highlights

- Conversation-first UI around contacts and sessions (not folders)
- Microsoft Graph (Outlook) and IMAP + SMTP
- Opt-in folder sync after sign-in
- Soft-delete messages; hide sessions without wiping mail
- Local SQLite; protocol traffic stays in Rust
- Licensed under **GPL-3.0-only**

### Downloads

Platform installers are attached by the Release workflow (**Windows** and **macOS** Apple Silicon + Intel). If assets are still uploading, wait for the [Release](https://github.com/Enkialon/Postlet/actions) workflow to finish.
